title: Gary Nolan presents his injury research the night before the site visit

tellings.quote: I was actually at the the New Mexico site and we hadn't gone there yet it was the night before and we were all just hanging out having a beer and Gary decided he was going to share his research with us and photos

plain: In 2016, the night before a group visited a site in New Mexico, a researcher named Garry Nolan sat with them over beers and showed them his research and photos on injuries, the story goes. Diana Pasulka, who comes on the show to talk about UFOs and religion, says she was there: "we were all just hanging out having a beer and Gary decided he was going to share his research with us and photos." She tells it as a first-hand memory of how the trip began, before anyone had seen the site itself.
